messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"book_code":"2ES","chapter":10,"verses":[{"verse":21,"text":"For you see that our sanctuary has been laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed,","chapter":10},{"verse":22,"text":"our lute has been brought low, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is plundered, our holy things are defiled, and the name that we are called is profaned. Our free men are despitefully treated, our priests are burned, our Levites have gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled and our wives ravished, our righteous men carried away, our little ones betrayed, our young men are brought into bondage, and our strong men have become weak.","chapter":10},{"verse":23,"text":"What is more than all, the seal of Zion has now lost the seal of her honor, and is delivered into the hands of those who hate us.","chapter":10},{"verse":24,"text":"Therefore shake off your great heaviness, and put away from yourself the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty One may be merciful to you again, and the Most High may give you rest, even ease from your troubles.”","chapter":10},{"verse":25,"text":"It came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face suddenly began to shine exceedingly, and her countenance flashed like lightning, so that I was very afraid of her, and wondered what this meant.","chapter":10},{"verse":26,"text":"Behold, suddenly she made a great and very fearful cry, so that the earth shook at the noise.","chapter":10},{"verse":27,"text":"I looked, and behold, the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city built, and a place shown itself from large foundations. Then I was afraid, and cried with a loud voice,","chapter":10},{"verse":28,"text":"“Where is Uriel the angel, who came to me at the first? For he has caused me to fall into this great trance, and my end has turned into corruption, and my prayer a reproach!”","chapter":10},{"verse":29,"text":"As I was speaking these words, behold, the angel who had come to me at first came to me, and he looked at me.","chapter":10},{"verse":30,"text":"Behold, I lay as one who had been dead, and my understanding was taken from me. He took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me on my feet, and said to me,","chapter":10},{"verse":31,"text":"“What ails you? Why are you so troubled? Why is your understanding and the thoughts of your heart troubled?”","chapter":10},{"verse":32,"text":"I said, “Because you have forsaken me; yet I did according to your words, and went into the field, and, behold, I have seen, and still see, that which I am not able to explain.”","chapter":10},{"verse":33,"text":"He said to me, “Stand up like a man, and I will instruct you.”","chapter":10},{"verse":34,"text":"Then I said, “Speak on, my Lord; only don’t forsake me, lest I die before my time.","chapter":10},{"verse":35,"text":"For I have seen what I didn’t know, and hear what I don’t know.","chapter":10},{"verse":36,"text":"Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?","chapter":10},{"verse":37,"text":"Now therefore I beg you to explain to your servant what this vision means.”","chapter":10},{"verse":38,"text":"He answered me, “Listen to me, and I will inform you, and tell you about the things you are afraid of, for the Most High has revealed many secret things to you.","chapter":10},{"verse":39,"text":"He has seen that your way is righteous, because you are continually sorry for your people, and make great lamentation for Zion.","chapter":10},{"verse":40,"text":"This therefore is the meaning of the vision.","chapter":10}]}
